  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Entity Value'>">

]>

  <!-- Comprehensive test comment incorporating all requested entities & CDATA -->
  <?target-pi processing instruction data with &internal; reference?>
  <child sub:id="1" xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing unparsed markup: <child>&internal;</child> &ext;
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (title, body)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p-entity "<!ENTITY gen-ent 'General Entity Text'>">
  %p-entity;
  <!ENTITY custom '&gen-ent; appended with more data'>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/document" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comment testing entity nesting and CDATA mixing -->
  <section>
    <title>Title &custom;</title>
    <body>
      <![CDATA[
        Some complex CDATA block with <tags> and entities like &custom; inside.
      ]]>
    </body>
  </section>
</document>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY combined "&base; Plus">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY external-doc SYSTEM "ext.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.org/catalog" xmlns:m="http://xml.org/metadata" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment before processing instruction and CDATA -->
  <?meta-pi command="initialize"?>
  <m:metadata>
    <![CDATA[
      <m:info>Raw metadata with &combined;</m:info>
    ]]>
  </m:metadata>
  <item>&combined;</item>
</catalog>
```

    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&e3;</record>
</archive>
